notes: Configure OPEN_SCIENCE_VCR_FORECAST_PROVIDERS_FILE on the control plane. The example is disabled and is not a real HealthFlux API.

For the hosted Compose stack, set OPEN_SCIENCE_VCR_FORECAST_HOST_DIR to an operator-owned directory containing providers.json and the token files referenced under /run/evimed/vcr-forecast/. Only open-science-web mounts this directory, read-only; the R service and DSH runtime do not.
Credentials stay outside the runtime. Numeric patient projections require the existing source grant and destination permission.
Cost is provider-reported; missing prices and unknown billing outcomes remain unknown. maxJobCost limits subsequent known/estimated-cost batches and is not a hard provider-side billing guarantee.
A config edit disables or rolls back future batches. Existing predictions retain their actual version.
The adapter supplies marginal endpoint forecasts; it does not claim a joint generative event-path model.
